Take those items to Yries Lightfingers at atop the Obsidian Throne and trade them for the Magmammoth Harness. Use the harness on the Tame Magmammoth at on the Burning Ascent. During the Lunar Festival, 84 Lunar Festival Elders appear around the world; some are located in towns, others in instances, and yet more are simply in the wild. You can receive a Coin of Ancestry from each Elder once a year. Elders may also tell you the location of up to 5 other Elders in nearby zones. Coins of Ancestry can be turned in for several tailoring and engineering patterns, as well as other items. Each coin you receive also generates 75 faction reputation with either the Horde or Alliance. Lushwater Oasis , just south of the Crossroads, is one of three major oases in the Northern Barrens. It is notable for containing the entrance to the accursed Wailing Caverns. Kolkar centaur stalk between the trees, eager to hunt the wild beasts coming to drink. The oasis narrowly missed destruction during the Cataclysm, and the southernmost pools appear to have partially dried up as a result. It is directly on the edge of the Great Divide. Due to its closeness to the Wailing Caverns and Crossroads, this is a popular spot to fish for Deviate Fish, the integral ingredient in the popular Savory Deviate Delight.

__NOTOC__ Lurielle is a frost nymph that functions as a diplomat for members of the Horde and the Alliance that enter the Frozen Glade. She sends the newcomers to the Howling Fjord to the Vibrant and Twisted Glades, to battle against the volatile and destructive forces which swept through them and the chaos they have caused. In several quests, she expresses her feelings of guilt and regret for her past measures to make to stop the corruption. Lurielle tries to reclaim the glades and restore what was lost, but not everything is replaceable. She fears that much is beyond saving, but refuses to give up hope.

Lunarfall Excavation is available to Alliance players upon upgrading the garrison to level 2. After completing Things Are Not Goren Our Way (Alliance), Lunarfall Excavation will unlock and be given to the player for free. It allows you to gather Draenor Ores and Draenic Stone once a day, which are used for work orders to gain more Draenor ores. A level 1 mine grants 8 deposits, level 2 grants ~13 deposits, level 3 grants ~18 deposits. The Horde equivalent is the Frostwall Mine.

The Luminous Luminaries is an event in which adventurers go to Vashj'ir to gather Luminescent Research Notes for Bo Bobble and Max Megablast who can be found by Edgar Fish 'N' Sea their submarine. Bringing luminescent creatures back to the submarine will cause it to scan you, and grant you notes for each creature collected. Be mindful of the Whale Shark, who will eat you if you have your lamp on. The submarine will not be able to scan you, if your light is off.

Luminescent Research Notes are obtained by bringing one or more of the following luminescent creatures to Edgar Fish 'N' Sea in the Scalding Chasm in the Abyssal Depths: *Luminescent Eel *Luminescent Grouper *Luminescent Jelly The rate of notes obtained triples if one of each type is brought to the sub. From then on, until the creatures stop following you, it's just a matter of avoiding the Whale Shark by turning the light on the diving helmet off and back on.
Luminescent Eels are eels located in the Underlight Canyon in the Abyssal Depths. If a diving helm is worn, they can be brought back to Edgar Fish 'N' Sea for Luminescent Research Notes.
Luminescent Jellies are jellyfish located in the Underlight Canyon in the Abyssal Depths. If a diving helm is worn, they can be brought back to Edgar Fish 'N' Sea for Luminescent Research Notes.
Luminescent Groupers are groupers located in Korthun's End in the Abyssal Depths. If a diving helm is worn, they can be brought back to Edgar Fish 'N' Sea for Luminescent Research Notes.
Lumpy is a bear located in Arathi Basin during Brawl: Comp Stomp for Alliance players.
Luminous Groupers are groupers located off the coast of Vol'dun and Zuldazar.
__NOTOC__ Lurching Blossoms are spitters located in Serenity Falls in the Jade Forest.
Luminescent Slugs are sea slugs located in Bloodfin Village in Nazjatar.
Lunar Preservation is the starting quest for players to be able to transmogrify the Lunar Festival flower crowns when the world event is not active.
Lurking Observers are eye servants of N'Zoth located in the Veiled Stair.
Lurking Horrors are mistlurkers located in the Clutch of Corruption in the Emerald Nightmare. They hide in patches of dense purple fog.
Lurking Rays are rays located off the coast of Darkshore. They swim in packs of three.
Lustrous Golden Plumage drops from The Golden Serpent in Kings' Rest.
Lunarfall Peacekeepers are draenei located in Lunarfall. They can be recruited by talking to Officer Torluun. If Festive Outfits is active, they will appear as Merry Peacekeepers.
__NOTOC__ Lunarfall Infantry are gnomes located in Lunarfall. They can be recruited by talking to Captain Towix. If Festive Outfits is active, they will wear festive suits.
Luminous Jellyweed drops from Blackwater Behemoth in the Eternal Palace.
Lumps of Sand are located on the beach at Unga Ingoo in Krasarang Wilds.
Luminous Ink is created with Inscription (15); taught by trainers.
Lunar Shrapnel is an Azerite trait available to Balance druids.
Lurking Fearspinner are spiders located in the Banewood in Revendreth.
__NOTOC__ Lusterwheat Flour is sold by trade good vendors in the Shadowlands.
Lurking Soulstalkers are gargon located in the Grove of Terror in Revendreth.
Lurking Savagemane Juveniles are raptors located in Zuldazar during Greener Pastures.
Lurker in the Night is a mogu ghost located in the Throne of Thunder.
Luminous Leystone Outcropping is a mining vein found at the Ley-Ruins of Zarkhenar in Azsuna.
Luminous Monelite Deposit is a mining vein found in Drustvar and Nazmir.
__NOTOC__ Lunarfall Raccoons are raccoons located in Lunarfall.
__NOTOC__ Luminous Flux is a crafting reagent which is used in varieties crafting item at several professions. It is sold by trade good vendors around the world.
Lurking Lashers are lashers located at the Banks of Life in Ardenweald.
